Image quality test: Sonnet vs Haiku

Each image scored 1–5 for "would we use this in an ad or flyer". Biggest disagreements first (red border = 2+ points apart). Green 4–5 · amber 3 · red 1–2 (would be hidden).

  • 47 images scored by both models.
  • Same score: 36 · within 1 point: 42 · disagree on 'hide as weak (1-2)': 5
  • Sonnet would hide 9 · Haiku would hide 14
  • Cost of this test: Sonnet $0.33, Haiku $0.02. For 1,925 images: Sonnet ~$13, Haiku ~$0.76

4social ad graphic with two-photo collage (bacon close-up, hand seasoning avocado toast)
  • Headline is bold and legible with a clean layout, but the text is heavy and the side photos have a mismatched look (the bacon is studio-quality and the toast photo is casual).
